# gstwebrtc-api

These JavaScript modules are vendored from GStreamer's `gst-plugins-rs`
repository:

- Upstream: <https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gst-plugins-rs>
- Commit: `22d4fa0ed4b648ae5828d59854acdf1b0696dc9c`
- Component: `net/webrtc/gstwebrtc-api/src`
- License: Mozilla Public License 2.0

Only the ES modules required by the browser consumer and remote controller are
included. The source files are unmodified.
